correctness.rationale: Complete Kingman merger-history counting proves the uniform ordered-composition law and unbiased internal histories. A direct fixed-pair coalescent recurrence yields the conditional cherry regression. Exact falling-factorial moments prove \(\operatorname{Cov}(C_n,D_{n,k})\) for all \(n\ge5\) and k; an elementary polynomial sum with independent exponential clock means proves \(5/18\). Boundary sizes n=2,3,4 and rate/mutation normalizations are handled explicitly. A standalone Fraction checker independently evaluates 5,715 exact identities, a finite state recursion and 59,602 fully enumerated merger histories; finite checks are additional evidence, not a proof for all n.

value.rationale: Cherries measure local genealogical topology and doubleton branch length is the expected exposure for mutations present in precisely two sampled sequences. Their exact levelwise covariance profile has a definite positive sign and depends nontrivially on both sample size and ancestral lineage level. The integrated sample-size-invariant \(5/18\) mixed moment links two standard evolutionary summaries even while expected cherry count increases linearly and expected doubleton length stays fixed. This is a concrete motivated structural dependence law and not a marginal-count recomputation.
